_readme: Image manifest. kind 'motion' = an animated CSS motion-graphic tile (no file, no illustration) shown in that slot. To use a real photo: put responsive WebP files at -.webp, then set kind to 'photo' with src, widths, width, height, source, licence and attribution (the tile is replaced by a normal ). 'graphic' = a single designed file such as the social card. See docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md.
